# PSL implementation loader

This directory intentionally contains a loader rather than a redistributed copy of `PSL.py`. The upstream research implementation is available from `weixiaoqimath/persistent_sheaf_Laplacians`, but the public GitHub repository did not contain a license at the time this package was prepared. To avoid redistributing third-party code without explicit licensing terms, place a local copy at:

```text
external/persistent_sheaf_Laplacians/PSL.py
```

or set `PSL_UPSTREAM_DIR` to the directory containing `PSL.py`.
